info.title: Intentra API
info.description: Intentra control plane: OIDC identity, projects, members, runners and events.

get.summary: Start the OIDC authorization code + PKCE flow
Finish the OIDC flow: verify state, exchange the code, provision the user, set the session cookie

302.description: Session established, redirect to the app

post.summary: Delete the local session and clear the cookie

200.description: Session deleted; redirectUrl is the RP-initiated logout URL when the IdP supports it

post.summary: Create a one-time runner registration token (TTL 15 minutes)
Redeem a registration token; the runner token is returned once and stored hashed
Publish a signed runner release; a repeat publish updates the same version

400.description: The manifest, its signature or its size is invalid

503.description: Release publishing or the release key is not configured
Release publishing or the release key is not configured

get.summary: Resolve the update for the authenticated runner
Stream a release artifact verified against the signed manifest

200.description: Artifact bytes with Content-Length and a sha-256 Digest

502.description: The artifact source failed, timed out or returned other bytes

post.summary: Record an applied, rolled-back or failed runner update

put.summary: Pin a runner version or disable auto-update

get.summary: Intent with its front-office card and open escalations

post.summary: Post a user message to the front-office conversation
Answer an escalation; the answer becomes an accepted decision

410.description: Escalation expired and applied its default

post.summary: Send an intent back to build with a reason
Restart intake for a draft intent whose intake failed

200.description: Intent with a new intake stage and job

409.description: The intent is not a draft or an intake stage or job is active

get.summary: Latest spec with its acceptance criteria and definition of done
Decisions, findings and verdicts behind the intent
Runner WebSocket: hello, heartbeat, job offers and job events
get.description: Upgrade with the runner token in the Authorization header (Bearer) or the token query parameter. Job-scoped messages carry jobId and a monotonically increasing seq; seq is idempotent.

401.description: Unknown, revoked or expired runner token

get.summary: Prometheus text metrics for stages, jobs, findings and tokens
Hybrid memory search inside one project
Project memory graph, served from Postgres when FalkorDB is degraded
